metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the tool at [output/main.js](/workspace/output/main.js). It runs as `node output/main.js ...`, uses only the Node standard library, writes `.bbl` on success, writes the required error JSON on exit `1`, and emits the structured JSON log when `--log` is provided.

Verified locally with `node --check output/main.js` and smoke runs against `plain.bst`, `alpha.bst`, `unsrt.bst`, and `abbrv.bst`, plus extra cases for `.aux` citation extraction, style macros, crossref inheritance/parent inclusion, duplicate keys, unresolved macros, and alpha-label generation. I could not do a byte-for-byte comparison against the historic `bibtex 0.99c` binary here because no `bibtex` executable is installed in the environment.
